name: ANSI/IEEE thermal circuit breaker symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for thermal circuit breaker, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The thermal breaker form adds a temperature-responsive protection concept to the circuit-interruption path. Reading it requires both the overload characteristic and the device's short-circuit rating; the small protection modifier is not a complete time-current curve.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Keep the thermal function linked to the breaker it operates.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A thermal qualifier describes protection response, while a trip-contact symbol describes a separate control connection.
